# CHUM — A Tribute to Phish

> San Francisco Bay Area Phish tribute band active since 2010, performing Phish's intricate compositions and multi-era live improvisation across Northern California and the West Coast.

- **Official Website:** https://chumphishtribute.com/
- **Press Kit & Hi-Res Assets:** https://chumphishtribute.com/press.html
- **Live Recordings (47+ full concerts on Live Music Archive):** https://archive.org/details/ChumATributeToPhish
- **Facebook:** https://www.facebook.com/ChumPhishTribute
- **Instagram:** https://www.instagram.com/chumphishband
- **Booking Inquiries:** nobrainerproductions831@gmail.com (No Brainer Productions)
- **General Band Contact:** chumphishtribute@gmail.com

## About the Band
Founded in 2010 in the San Francisco Bay Area, Chum is one of the longest-running Phish tribute acts in the United States. The band is known for tackling Phish's most demanding composed material alongside open-ended, multi-era improvisation spanning Phish 1.0 through 4.0, plus Phish's live arrangements of classic rock covers.

## Lineup
- **Eric Ingersoll** — Keys & Vocals
- **Chris Detrick** — Guitar & Vocals
- **Chad Kimner** — Bass & Vocals
- **Alex Bowman** — Drums & Vocals
- **Eric Schiff** — Guitar (occasional guest appearances from Sweden)
- *In memory of John Greene (Keys & Vocals, March 2014 – July 2025)*

## Press & Critical Reception
- **Santa Cruz Sentinel (March 19, 2025):** ["Phish tribute band Chum quite the catch at Woodhouse Brewing"](https://www.santacruzsentinel.com/2025/03/19/santa-cruz-phish-tribute-band-chum-quite-the-catch-at-woodhouse-brewing/)
- **Surrender to the Flow (Dick's 2026 Issue):** Featured in Sydne Kasle's national Phish tribute profile *"Phish Tributes: Capturing the Feeling I Forgot"* alongside Pink Talking Fish, The Last Rewind, and Kids Under the Carpet ([PDF](https://chumphishtribute.com/Images/press/surrender-to-the-flow-phish-tributes.pdf)).
  - On multi-era improvisation: *"...it's less about adapting to how Phish has evolved and more about being willing to sample from any of those eras on any given night."*
  - On repertoire & improvisation: *"Learning the hard stuff is academic. Learning to create new music in real time is the much more elusive goal."* — Chad Kimner
- **Tyler Blue (Veteran Music Promoter):** *"Very few bands out there even dare to embrace the intricate discipline of executing these songs properly. San Francisco's Chum has earned elite status amongst the Phish community with their rare ability to capture the essence of the band's razor-sharp precision, organic improvisation and playful spirit. From 1.0 to 4.0, they have it all dialed. Even the most jaded vets nod in approval."*
